qa.note: GEM shows 51.7627400, 14.3453979 as approximate. The plant address is Werner-von-Siemens-Strasse 16 in Cottbus, in the Sandow district. A map search of that street puts it near longitude 14.37 to 14.39, and the German Wikipedia article on the plant gives 51.7603, 14.3699. Both are about 2 kilometers east of GEM's point. Wikipedia is a lead only. No official document I found states coordinates. I did not change the location.
